senses.gloss:
अद्मन् अद्मन्, अ, n. (fr. rt. अद्), Ved. eating;
a meal; a house.
—अद्म-सद्, त्, m., Ved. seated
(with others) at a meal (?); seated at or busy in the
preparation of a meal (?); a cook (?); a mother (?).
—अद्मसद्य, अम्, n., Ved. the condition of an
अद्मसद्.
—अद्मसद्वन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. fit to be
a companion at a meal.
